reconstruction.summary: Python C-API wrapper that opens a Pinot reader library. Takes one argument (a path or options object), attempts to dlopen libpinot_reader.so, falls back to std::filebuf/ifstream on failure, and returns a handle as a Python int (void* cast to long).

side_effects: Allocation of void** handle (8 bytes) via operator_new
